semantics: Registry definitions (data/feature_registry/alphabuilders_factors_fresh.json) for features whose pre-contract ml-service form differs from them. Applied in ml-service build_feature_matrix only when the payload carries pit_contract_version equal to contract_version; artifacts record that version and serving builds with it, so artifacts without a version keep the pre-contract form byte-identical. Adjusted prices are derived from the raw bar and the same-day FinLab factor adj_close/close: FinLab's etl:adj_high/adj_low equal raw x adj_close/close to 4.3e-16 relative on every cell of a full capture, so training (sealed capture) and serving (D1 stock_prices plus canonical adj_close) read no adj_high/adj_low column. A comparison of two days' adjusted prices depends only on the ratio of their factors, so a vendor rebase of the whole series cannot change it. A tie (equal adjusted prices, including 1-ulp vendor noise on an ex-right day that removes exactly the distribution) is not a gap: the strict comparison carries tie_rel_tolerance. A row whose own or previous bar lacks a finite positive price or factor takes undefined_value, as the registry's pandas reference yields False on NaN. vola_cv_90d is a coefficient of variation of the raw close level over a fixed row window (the registry and its FinLab reference use raw close, see price_basis); fewer than window rows, a non-finite value in the window or a zero mean gives undefined_value, as the reference yields NaN there. The pre-contract forms: tech_gap_down = min((open - prev_close)/prev_close, 0) on raw prices; vola_cv_90d = std(ret1, 90) / max(|mean(ret1, 90)|, 1e-9) on adjusted daily returns. A version's definitions are frozen in ml-service pit_contract._FEATURE_DEFINITIONS_SHA256; changing them needs a new contract version.

vola_cv_90d.price_basis: raw close. The registry names close here while its adjusted-price factors name *_adj (tech_gap_up/tech_gap_down), and the FinLab reference implementations read price:收盤價 (tools/finlab_alphabuilders_factor_backtest.py:174 and :288, tools/finlab_strategy_spec_backtest.py:1055 and :560), which is the raw close.
vola_cv_90d.value: rolling sample standard deviation (ddof 1, as pandas rolling(90).std()) of raw close over the last window rows / rolling mean of raw close over the same rows
